definitions.explanation: The most abundant type of blood cell, responsible for carrying oxygen throughout the body. Contains hemoglobin, which gives blood its red color.

examples.japanese: {赤血球|せっけっきゅう}の{数|かず}が{少|すく}ない。
examples.english: The red blood cell count is low.

examples.japanese: {赤血球|せっけっきゅう}は{酸素|さんそ}を{運|はこ}ぶ{役割|やくわり}がある。
examples.english: Red blood cells have the role of carrying oxygen.

examples.japanese: {血液検査|けつえきけんさ}の{結果|けっか}、{赤血球|せっけっきゅう}の{数値|すうち}が{基準値|きじゅんち}を{下回|したまわ}っていたので、{貧血|ひんけつ}の{疑|うたが}いがあると{言|い}われた。
examples.english: The blood test results showed that my red blood cell count was below the standard range, so I was told there might be anemia.

notes:
A compound of {赤|せっ} (red), {血|けっ} (blood), and {球|きゅう} (sphere). The three main types of blood cells are frequently discussed in health and science contexts.

RELATED BLOOD CELL TYPES:
- {白血球|はっけっきゅう}: white blood cell — fights infection
- {血小板|けっしょうばん}: platelet — aids in blood clotting

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {赤血球|せっけっきゅう}の{数|かず}: red blood cell count
- {赤血球|せっけっきゅう}が{減少|げんしょう}する: red blood cells decrease
- {赤血球|せっけっきゅう}が{増加|ぞうか}する: red blood cells increase
- {赤血球|せっけっきゅう}{沈降速度|ちんこうそくど}: erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR)
